description: Percentage within a -minute walk of their nearest rail station - WMCA is a series of datasets listed in Birmingham City Observatory open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Office for National Statistics. This is the percentage of people living less than a 30-minute walk of their nearest rail station. Travel time to Rail Stations analysis was performed in collaboration with the Ordnance Survey (OS). Distance and travel time analysis requires identification of origins and destinations, and a routable network from origin to destination. Coverage: West Midlands Combined Authority area, including Birmingham. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per month, area, counter or year), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are west midlands combined authority, wmca, train, distance. The portal shows 9 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-cityobservatory-birmingham-gov-uk-portal.
